publication gate misses root path "/", non-ASCII absolute paths, and spaced credentials with values under four characters. lib/result-schema.mjs:202,228
card truncates facet values at 92 characters while facet_identity permits unrestricted length, so a long facet differs between card and markdown. lib/profile-report.mjs:267

sanitized-value provenance is a String subclass that does not survive serialization, so verify --run's rebuild reads a digest off its spelling; that path compares and discards, writing and rendering nothing. A typed wrapper in the JSON changes the schema shape everywhere and belongs in its own issue.
run.suite_digest is published as the caller supplied it because the field's declared shape is a digest and it must stay comparable with the suite manifest.
contract.artifact_bytes is published only for results built under shipped contract files; verify --run falls back to the canonical digest otherwise.
